env TZ=UTC
at 2026-07-12T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix lease-

exec card --actor cache-primer lease acquire search-cache-segment --ttl 2m
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/active.txt
! stderr .

at 2026-07-12T12:01:59Z
exec card lease show search-cache-segment
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/active.txt
! stderr .

at 2026-07-12T12:02:00Z
exec card lease list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/empty.txt
! stderr .
! exec card lease show search-cache-segment
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/show-missing.txt
! exec card --actor cache-primer lease release search-cache-segment
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/release-missing.txt
! exec card --actor cache-primer lease renew search-cache-segment --ttl 7m
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/renew-missing.txt
